gloss: same trade; same line of business

definitions.gloss: same trade; same line of business; same industry
definitions.explanation: Being in the same profession, trade, or industry as someone else. Commonly used as a prefix in compounds referring to people or organizations in the same field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同業者|どうぎょうしゃ}→同業者：24126_dougyousha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To exchange information with people in the same business.

examples.japanese: {同業|どうぎょう}{他社|たしゃ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧、うち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: Compared to other companies in the same industry, our prices are lower.

examples.japanese: {同業|どうぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧らしい。
examples.english: According to what I heard from a friend in the same line of work, the whole industry seems to be in a tough situation.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{同|どう}→同〜：03962_dou⟧ (same) + {業|ぎょう} (business/trade). Functions primarily as a prefix in compounds, most commonly ⟦{同業者|どうぎょうしゃ}→同業者：24126_dougyousha⟧ (people in the same trade).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{同業者|どうぎょうしゃ}→同業者：24126_dougyousha⟧: person in the same trade/industry
- {同業|どうぎょう}{他社|たしゃ}: other companies in the same industry
- {同業|どうぎょう}⟦{組合|くみあい}→組合：02669_kumiai⟧: trade association; guild
- {同業種|どうぎょうしゅ}: same type of business

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧: colleague — people at the same workplace, not necessarily same profession
- ⟦{競合|きょうごう}→競合：05082_kyougou⟧: competition; rival — emphasizes the competitive aspect
- ⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧: industry — the field itself rather than the shared membership
